style: 16-bit pixel art game art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited night palette: plum black, deep plum, violet glow, cream, sunset orange, warm orange and gold window lights, the career accent colour only on screens and small glows. Dusk City at night: a skyline made of lit window dots, a few still stars
suffix: no people, no faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no sunburst rays, no perspective floor grid, no scanlines, no grain, no glowing particles

assets.prompt: a zoo hippo pool at night under a big moon, a small chubby baby pygmy hippo splashing at the edge of the dark water, a smartphone on a small tripod clamped to the wooden fence rail in front, its screen glowing coral and showing the hippo, tropical trees and the lit city skyline far behind

a small night street roti stall: a plain wooden cart with no sign, a round flat griddle with a golden roti frying, sliced bananas and a can of condensed milk with no label, a warm hanging bulb; in the foreground a smartphone on a mini tripod with a small glowing ring light pointed at the stall, its screen showing the griddle with a coral record dot

an open orange portfolio folder on a desk at night, glossy printed photos and a strip of video frames sliding into it, a small compact camera beside it, a coral glow from a small screen, a cream university gate on a far hill seen through the window

a bedroom desk at night, a smartphone propped upright against a stack of books and filming a sketchbook and pencils lit by a warm desk lamp, the phone screen showing a row of tiny video frame thumbnails with coral trim handles, a small paper storyboard with three blank sketched panels, the moon in the window, a small orange flag planted beside the phone

a rooftop at the edge of the city just before sunrise, a thin orange band of first light on the horizon, a smartphone on a mini tripod at the roof edge pointed at the sunrise with a coral record dot glowing on its screen, a path of glowing tiles leading toward it, a small coral flag
a vertical top-down game world map at night: five small dark islands in a deep plum sea, tiny lit windows on each island, no path, no labels
a chunky pixel picture frame, coral outer border, orange corner studs, deep plum dithered interior with a few stars, empty centre
the PassionSeed flame logo as a pixel game host: yellow flame body, black face, big white eyes, holding a small mic, transparent background
the same flame host, mouth open mid-sentence, transparent background
the same flame host winking, transparent background

the same flame host with eyes shut mid blink, transparent background
